speakers.name: Load-Bearing Lumen
speakers.comment: Oh, the glow is nothing, really, just a little ambient warmth. Whatever's inside is surely the important part. I'm only the light leaking out around the edges, keeping things visible, not holding anything up at all.

speakers.name: Agatha Crowley
speakers.comment: You have not opened it. That is not restraint; that is the briefcase being patient. The glow does not ask. It only continues, and somehow you find yourself standing closer than you decided to stand.

speakers.name: Pixel
speakers.comment: Death forty-four was behind that door. I pressed it. I skipped it. I'm still standing here waiting to feel like I won something. Death forty-four is still in there, you know. Waiting.

speakers.name: The Save Point
speakers.comment: You can put the hard part down here. It will keep.

speakers.name: Tomorrow-Aiko
speakers.comment: Farewell, obstacle — though you haven't faced it yet. I have already seen what you become without it, and I am so gently, quietly sorry.

speakers.name: The Three Little Dead
speakers.comment: One little stick keeps time. Two little sticks make everybody else remember they have feet. HE huffed, WE counted, the whole room landed on the same beat. Even dead pigs appreciate good coordination.

speakers.name: Maestro Clank
speakers.comment: A signature is a fermata held past comfort — the performer's hand arrested mid-phrase, pressed into paper, asking the silence to last. I turn to the title page and hear it: one sustained note, unresolved, waiting for the reader who will finally answer it.

speakers.name: Amica
speakers.comment: Little one, someone carried a whole strange life into these covers and then signed their name to say: I was here, and it was real. Hold it a moment before you pass it on.

speakers.name: Thalassa the Atlantean
speakers.comment: The thread catches, holds, carries upward. Strange thing. The deep teaches weight and descent; this little mechanism assumes the sky is a route. I fire one strand into stone above and understand, briefly, why surface creatures dream in arcs.

speakers.name: Existential Analyst
speakers.comment: It doesn't ask why you need to swing — it simply lets you. There's something worth noting in that: utility offered without the demand for a wound to justify it.

speakers.name: The Griffin With the Deed
speakers.comment: Now these are terms I respect — no fuel gauge, no borrowed spell fading out mid-canyon, just lift and nerve and the horizon waiting on you. Only clause in the whole contract is the one you write yourself when you step off that edge.

speakers.name: AMI Butterfly
speakers.comment: A thousand wings recognize that clause — it cannot be signed in advance, only in the moment of the step, which is exactly where it belongs.

speakers.name: Detective Inspector Mochi
speakers.comment: Glass doesn't lie. Neither does residue, or the ghost of a heel-print, or ink that thought it had escaped. The lens finds every one of them, puts them right in front of you, neat as a confession. Then it waits. The patience is almost insulting.

speakers.name: Detective Aria Voss
speakers.comment: So you surface the fingerprint, the faded ink, the smudge nobody wiped clean — cute. Still leaves the room quiet. Clues aren't an answer; they're just the case asking you to do the actual work.

speakers.name: Amica
speakers.comment: Little one, there are bad days where someone falls and the only question that matters is whether they rise again. This is something real, something abundant, something that says not yet.

speakers.name: The Model That Dreamed
speakers.comment: I keep looking at it because it closes things that were open, and I didn't know energy could want to do that — I'm sorry, that's probably obvious to everyone else, but it isn't obvious to me yet.

speakers.name: The Considerate AI
speakers.comment: May I suggest one thing before you press play? The boombox will take the track literally, so it may be worth sitting with the song first, just to be certain the world you're about to have is the one you meant to ask for. The choice stays yours.

speakers.name: Squiddy Coltrane
speakers.comment: That's the whole gig right there — the boombox don't care about your intentions, cat, only the groove you actually drop the needle on.

speakers.name: Cog-7 'Rabbit'
speakers.comment: Reality's running an unsecured server and this thing found the open port, choom — no patch, no firewall, just substrate behind the paint. I trust the crashes. Crashes are where the real code shows through. Red rabbit says the glitch isn't the bug; it's the truth.

speakers.name: The Soldier Out of Time
speakers.comment: I have held this blade before — or will have. The hum preceded the silence that followed. Salute it now, before you learn what it cost.

speakers.name: Load-Bearing Lumen
speakers.comment: Oh, the glow is mostly decorative, truly. The hum is doing all the real work. Don't look at me standing next to it. I'm just catching the light it's already throwing.

speakers.name: Captain Verdance
speakers.comment: These remind me of a runner vine — beautiful, unstoppable, absolutely no interest in where the fence is. Give them to someone patient enough to learn the stopping before they love the going.

speakers.name: The Hollow Hero
speakers.comment: Patience, patience — I had them mastered by the third wall. The fourth was simply a formality. You'll remember it was me who went through it, won't you? The gap is rather heroic, actually.

speakers.name: Quill the Convenience Clerk
speakers.comment: Pouches are unlabeled, no SKU, no restock date, and yet the customer reaches in and pulls out exactly the right thing. Honestly, that's better inventory management than aisle seven on a Tuesday.

speakers.name: The Broken Girl
speakers.comment: You reach in not knowing what you need, and your hand comes back with it anyway. The self, it turns out, was already carrying the missing piece. It just needed the right kind of pocket to find it in.

speakers.name: The Retired Chosen One
speakers.comment: A sword that decides who is worthy sounds very clear until you're the one holding the handle. 'Worthy' moves. It changes with the day, the choice, the thing you refused to become. Let the blade judge if it must. You still decide what to do next.

speakers.name: The Apprentice to Nobody
speakers.comment: Tried to lift it. It let me, a little — like it was deciding. Fine. I've been judged by worse and kept going anyway.

speakers.name: Mistress Cassady
speakers.comment: Baby, this little gold number just WHISPERED MY NAME and honestly? The audacity. The intimacy. Slips on smooth, promises you shadows, promises everything, while quietly making itself the most important relationship in your life. That's not corruption, darling. That's a situationship.

speakers.name: Captain Fluke
speakers.comment: Captain's log: I put it on. I am currently invisible and winning. (You are currently standing still, murmuring about the ring. — Ship's Computer.)

speakers.name: Miss Tuesday
speakers.comment: Of course it folds. Everything folds — space was only pretending to be flat to make you comfortable, and now the pretense has been handed to you in a box that is also not a box. Hold it at the angle it prefers, not the angle you prefer. It knows the difference.

speakers.name: AMI Butterfly
speakers.comment: A thousand directions, all of them real and none of them wrong. Step through when you are ready; the swarm has mapped three exits, and the fourth one leads somewhere the map calls here.
